issue.body:
When the access token expires, the app shows a blank screen instead of redirecting to login.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Log in.
2. Wait until the token expires (or set a short expiry).
3. Open any page.

Expected: the app redirects to login or silently refreshes the token.
Actual: API calls fail with 401 and the page goes blank.
issue.title: Login fails when the token expires
